title: Outlook for Mac: DLP policy tips and override
summary: Hold: the Purview override path skips the policy-template choices required to reach the rule editor. The documented default, PowerShell override parameter and roadmap facts are supported, and the briefing correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting Mac-support documentation.

claims.claim: Outlook for Mac now supports DLP policy tips.
claims.quote: Outlook for Mac now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks.

claims.claim: The roadmap says detected sensitive content produces inline tips or pop-ups based on administrator-configured rules.
claims.quote: When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: second table row
claims.claim: The printed route goes directly from + Create policy to Create or customize advanced DLP rules, then to the override option.
claims.quote:
Select Custom from the Categories list.
Select Custom from the Regulations list.
Select Full directory under Admin units.
Select only the Exchange email location.
On the Define policy settings page, select Create or customize advanced DLP rules.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].ui.path and its rendered route with 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom > Full directory > Exchange email > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > User notifications > Policy tips > Show the policy tip as a dialog for the end user before send > Allow override from M365 services'. The note lists the missing choices, but they must be in the navigable route itself; the Custom template selections decide how the wizard proceeds.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule with Name, Policy, BlockAccess true and NotifyAllowOverride WithJustification creates a DLP rule with justification-based override.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpComplianceRule to create data loss prevention (DLP) rules ... The NotifyAllowOverride parameter specifies the notification override options ... WithJustification: Allows overrides with justification.

claims.claim: DLP rule configuration determines the policy-tip text.
claims.quote: For each rule in a DLP policy, you can configure policy tips to: ... You can use the default text (see the tables below) or enter custom text about your organization's specific policies.

claims.claim: Learn describes the Cloud Policy setting as controlling the tip UI, not as changing which DLP rules are evaluated.
claims.quote: Searched: Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 configure policy settings PowerShell Graph API Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention policy tips Outlook.
